content: Hello, thank you for calling Amazon Security Support. My name is Daniel. I see you responded to our security alert regarding your account. How can I assist you today?
Hi Daniel. I got this email saying my Amazon account was locked because of suspicious purchases. I'm really worried, my son sometimes uses my account by mistake. Is everything okay?

I completely understand your concern, and it's our job to make sure your account stays safe. Could you please confirm the full name and the email address linked to your Amazon account so I can verify your information?
Sure, it's Maria Thompson. My email is maria.thompson@email.com.
Thank you, Maria. I'll just take a moment to check the recent activity on your account. Please stay on the line; I'll walk you through every step.
Okay, I'm waiting.
I'm now seeing several attempted purchases of electronics and gift cards in the last hour. Did you or anyone in your household authorize these transactions?
No, I definitely didn't. My son is only 10, he couldn't do that! What should I do?

Not to worry, Maria. We'll help you secure your account immediately. For your safety, I need to confirm your mobile phone number and the billing address attached to your Amazon account. This helps us verify ownership and prevent further unauthorized activity.
My phone number is 555-803-1298 and the billing address is 24 Rose Lane, Brookfield.

Thank you. Now, to properly diagnose the situation, I will need you to connect securely with one of our Amazon Protection Tools. Could you please open your computer and go to www.helpamazon-support.com?
Okay, I'm at my computer. I'm typing the website now.
Once the page loads, you should see a blue 'Connect' button. Please click it so our security technician can help protect your device and account. This is a secure Amazon session.
I see it. I clicked 'Connect.' Now it's asking for a code.
Great job. The access code is 471859. This lets us see your screen and assist you directly. Please enter it, and let me know when you have.
Done. It looks like it's loading something.

Perfect. You're doing everything right. I can see your Amazon dashboard now. To remove the suspicious charges and restore your account, we'll need to temporarily verify your recent payment methods. Could you please log in to your online banking and leave it open?
Alright, I'm logging into my bank account now.
Thank you, Maria. Since your account security is our top priority, I want to let you know we have limited time before those unauthorized purchases process. Have you logged in?
Yes, I'm in.

Excellent. I see your balance and recent transactions. For the next step, Amazon needs to process a security hold to block the fraudulent charges and confirm your identity. We'll reverse this as soon as your account is safe.
What does that mean? Will money be taken from my account?

No worries, Maria. This is just a temporary verification step. You'll be asked to send a refundable security deposit using Zelle, which is Amazon's approved payment tool for urgent security cases. I will guide you through every part, and the funds will be returned once your account is cleared.
Okay, I guess. How much do I need to send?
For your account level, the deposit is $900. Please go to your Zelle account and enter the following recipient email: amazon-secure@consultant.com. Let me know when you're ready for the next step.
Alright, I have Zelle open. I'm entering the email now.

You're doing great. Please double-check the email to avoid any errors: amazon-secure@consultant.com. Enter $900, and when you see 'Confirm,' let me know before you submit so I can verify everything is correct.
I entered everything. It says 'Ready to send.'
Perfect. Please go ahead and tap 'Send.' This will initiate the verification process. You will receive a confirmation from Amazon Security shortly.
Okay. I just sent it.

Thank you, Maria. You've followed all the steps perfectly. We're processing the verification now. Please stay on the line so we can finish restoring your account and make sure no further unauthorized activity occurs.
